source_note: Shape only. SECI FDRE tenders have specified assured peak-window blocks (for example 4,800 MWh as 1,200 MW over 4 h, amended to 6,000 MWh as 1,500 MW over 4 h) with relaxation allowances up to 25%, and awarded FDRE tariffs have clustered around INR 5.26-6.28/unit. Those figures informed the SHAPE of this obligation; the committed energy, relaxation fraction, and penalty rate here are scaled scenario assumptions for a 96-slot demo portfolio and are NOT a claim about any specific tender or contract.
